desc.zh: 从频次与先后顺序推导常数时间缓存淘汰。
desc.en: Derive constant-time cache eviction from frequency and recency.

complexity: O(1) average time per get/put; O(C) space for capacity C

concepts.name: LFU frequency buckets
concepts.description: Maintain oldest-first keys per frequency and the smallest live frequency.
